name: qa-hiring
description: QA hiring toolkit: 3 skills (interview-question-author, hiring-rubric-author, calibration-guide-author) producing ISTQB-aligned interview question banks, role-specific scoring rubrics, and interviewer-calibration guides for QA / SDET / test-lead / quality-manager roles.
